title: Frontbook fee validation Manifest
description: Durable record of every Run. A bare invocation of the skill advances this file. Written through on every stage transition, never only at the end.

seeded_from.description: data/run-matrix.csv@<sha256>. The skill refuses to start if the matrix no longer hashes to this; a changed matrix requires a deliberate --reseed.

database.description: Identity of the Postgres the Campaign ran against. An Attempt from a destroyed database is unreproducible, not trustworthy.

reachability.description: direct: URL-selectable by strategy UUID. mla_forced: no UUID; applied under the non-MLA twin with the local MLA stub forcing a positive TransUnion MLA report.

strategy_uuid.description: null for mla_forced codes, which have no UUID by design

expected.description: Copied from the matrix row at seed time so an Attempt stays interpretable if the matrix later changes.

status.description: DERIVED from the newest Attempt, never authored independently. halted = Mechanical Failure awaiting an agent. failed = Assertion Failure, which no agent may fix. stale = passed under a superseded Template Version and re-queued.

attempts.description: Append-only. An earlier Attempt is never overwritten: the evidence that made a result stale must survive alongside it.

stage.description: Last completed step. Also the resume point.

handles.description: Captured by explicit id at creation. NEVER resolved later by recency - see AGENTS.md rule 1.

provenance.description: What this Attempt actually ran against. Without it a render cannot be attributed to an Epoch.

template_version.description: git_sha_version of the rendered CMA template. THE epoch signal. Never inferred from a fee amount.

class.description: mechanical: the apparatus broke; an agent may fix and resume. assertion: a result, never fixed by an agent. environment: invalidates every subsequent Run, so the whole Campaign stops.

diagnosis.description: The matching FINDINGS.md entry, quoted, by number.

interventions.description: Fixes an agent applied mid-Campaign. Surfaced in the artifact, and persisted into local-stack/ so they replay on later builds.
